title: Transfer item: coherent
instructions: Choose the meaning that best fits the sentence.

parts.prompt: Although the proposal contained several complex ideas, its argument was coherent: each point followed logically from the one before it. What does “coherent” most nearly mean?

choice_rationales.A: The explanation after the colon says the points follow logically.
choice_rationales.B: The sentence comments on organisation, not length.
choice_rationales.C: Complex ideas are not necessarily emotional.
choice_rationales.D: No reaction from other people is described.

parts.hint: Use the explanation after the colon as a testable definition.
parts.correct_explanation: Because each point follows logically, coherent means logically connected.
